title: Not All Dimensions Are Equal: Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization with Grouped Quadratic Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.13674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linearizing softmax attention offers a route to efficient Transformer inference, but preserving pretrained attention remains challenging. We identify an important source of approximation error overlooked by standard linearization methods: a small number of outlier dimensions contribute disproportionately to query-key dot products and account for a large fraction of the approximation error. Motivated by this heterogeneity, we propose Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization (OAL), a dimension-aware method for constructing quadratic attention approximations. Starting from a second-order Taylor approximation, we introduce a Hadamard-product formulation that makes individual query-key contributions explicit. This formulation relaxes globally shared coefficients to support dimension-specific linear terms and cross-dimensional quadratic interactions while preserving separable evaluation. translated_title: 并非所有维度生而平等：基于分组二次核的离群值感知注意力线性化
translated_abstract: 线性化softmax注意力为高效的Transformer推理提供了一条途径，但如何在近似中保留预训练注意力仍然充满挑战。我们识别出一个被标准线性化方法所忽略的重要近似误差来源：一小部分离群维度对查询-键点积的贡献不成比例地大，并占据了近似误差的很大一部分。受这种异质性的启发，我们提出了离群值感知注意力线性化（Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization, OAL），这是一种用于构建二次注意力近似的维度感知方法。从二阶泰勒近似出发，我们引入了一种Hadamard乘积表述，使各个查询-键的独立贡献得以显式呈现。该表述放宽了全局共享系数的限制，以支持维度特定的线性项和跨维度的二次交互，同时保持可分离的计算方式。为了以更少的参数保留这种灵活性，OAL将维度进行分组（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现预训练注意力中少数离群维度主导了线性化的近似误差，并提出维度感知的OAL方法，通过Hadamard乘积表述将全局系数放宽为维度特定的线性项与跨维度二次交互，再以分组二次核在更少参数下实现高保真的注意力线性化。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that a small set of outlier dimensions dominates linearization approximation error, and proposes Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization (OAL), which uses a Hadamard-product formulation and grouped quadratic kernels to capture dimension-specific linear terms and cross-dimensional quadratic interactions for faithful and efficient linearized attention.
